Environment & Animal Welfare

Planned initiative

Care should extend beyond ourselves.

Healthy communities depend on healthy surroundings and compassionate coexistence with animals. Aashray intends to develop this pillar as its wider community mission grows.

01 / Environment & Animal Welfare

Our intended focus

Environmental awareness, community cleanliness, responsible care for shared spaces and animal welfare awareness are areas we may explore. Specific initiatives will be developed with suitable volunteers and partners.

02 / Environment & Animal Welfare

Where this stands today

This is a planned area of work. Activities, locations and participation opportunities will be announced when confirmed.

03 / Environment & Animal Welfare

Bring your experience

If you work in environmental education, community action or animal welfare, we welcome a conversation about how your experience could help shape responsible future initiatives.
